name: habblaud
description: Habblaud plugins, the pixel-art virtual office for your Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: habblaud
plugins.description: Habblaud mod: plan usage (5h and weekly) for the office, prompt notification when another session needs you, and the /habblaud command.

plugins.name: habblaud-permissoes
plugins.description: Approve or deny Claude Code permission requests and answer agent questions through Habblaud (PermissionRequest hook).

plugins.name: habblaud-mensagens
plugins.description: Send messages through Habblaud: what you type in the office enters the session as if you typed it in the terminal.
